request.text: A PowerShell session on WORKSTATION5 appears to be replicating credentials from the domain controller (DCSync). Contain host WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: A high-integrity PowerShell session of pgustavo (PID 7456) ran whoami /user and then connected from WORKSTATION5 to the domain controller's RPC endpoint mapper (135) and to its lsass RPC port (49674). A workstation process speaking directory replication RPC to the DC is DCSync credential theft; isolate WORKSTATION5 now.
